calendar_apply_globally_desc: If disabled, week-configuration settings apply only to dates inside journals and do not affect dates created by other plugins or Obsidian itself.
calendar_apply_globally_restart_hint: You might need to restart Obsidian for changes to take effect.
calendar_apply_globally_title: Apply week configuration to all dates in vault?
calendar_picker_first_week_desc: Which day in January the first week of the year must contain (1..7).
calendar_picker_start_week_on_desc: Which day to treat as the first day of the week.

match.preset=locale: Use the week settings defined by Obsidian's current locale.
match.preset=iso-8601: Week starts on Monday. First week of year includes the first Thursday (Jan 4th).
match.preset=western: Week starts on Sunday. First week of year includes the first Saturday (Jan 1st).
match.preset=middle-eastern: Week starts on Saturday. First week of year includes the first Friday (Jan 1st).
match.preset=custom: Define what day of week to treat as first and how the first week of year is determined.

calendar_preset_custom_summary: Week starts on {dayName}. First week of year includes Jan {firstDayOfYear}.
calendar_preset_iso_used: EU (excluding Portugal) and most other European countries, most of Asia and Oceania.
calendar_preset_western_used: Canada, United States, Iceland, Portugal, Japan, Taiwan, Thailand, Hong Kong, Macau, Israel, Egypt, South Africa, the Philippines, and most of Latin America.
journal_add_modal_anchor_description: This date is used to count custom intervals from. It cannot be changed after creating the journal.
journal_delete_mode_label: What to do with connected notes
journal_delete_mode_not_implemented_hint: Clear and Delete modes will land with the notes-IO service.
journal_edit_allow_before_description: Allow indexing before the anchor date. May produce negative numbers.
journal_edit_anchor_start_used: Start date is used as anchor date.
journal_edit_date_format_description: Used to format dates if not defined in variables (like {{date}}).

match.kind=date: New notes after this date won't be created.
match.kind=repeats: After creating this many notes, new notes won't be created.

journal_edit_fm_start_description: For weekly journals that span two years, the start date can differ from the date property.
journal_edit_reset_description: How the number changes over time.
journal_edit_sequence_enabled_descriptio: Assign numbers to notes (e.g. Day 1, Day 2, …).
journal_edit_start_number_description: Number assigned at the anchor date.
journal_edit_start_writing_custom_locked: Start date for custom intervals cannot be changed: it is used to count intervals from.
journal_edit_start_writing_description: New notes prior to this date won't be created.
journal_notes_not_rewritten_hint: Existing notes are not rewritten. You may need to update them manually.
journal_rename_modal_same_as_current_err: New name must differ from current name.
